scientific_question: Where and how consistently does finite-amplitude relation-conditioned curvature reverse the otherwise correct query-bound operator value, and does that failure support global magnitude control or relation-conditioned expression in v2?
claim_boundary: This is the final read-only local-fidelity architecture-selection gate on frozen development seeds 1901 and 1902. It does not train v2, fit a probe, use a relation or correctness oracle, or access formal seeds. After this gate, choose and register a v2 candidate on new development seeds rather than adding post hoc localization on 1901 and 1902.
established_chain: terminal fast weights support global expected-rank assembly
relation-LOO fast weights form query-addressable operators with exact-match binding
W_out-transduced operator value A is correctness-aligned
the local Jacobian J_b A strengthens raw and normalized correctness
the exact finite-amplitude response degrades semantic direction and robustly reverses H>A in both pilots

execution_contract.neural_replay_device: GPU with PyTorch intra-op and inter-op threads bounded to one

amplitude_path_contract.baseline: b_q is the full relation-LOO response preactivation
amplitude_path_contract.fixed_output: the trained action-margin covector W_out[action1]-W_out[action0] at its trained scale
amplitude_path_contract.scalar_field: orientation-antisymmetric W_out projection on all 28 canonical query edges
amplitude_path_contract.hodge_residual: apply the registered complete-graph residual projector independently at every lambda, relation, and subject
amplitude_path_contract.lambda_zero: the complete field and every residual must be exactly zero
amplitude_path_contract.lambda_one: must reproduce the prior exact-H estimands and actual intact-minus-LOO logit influence

aggregate_crossing_contract.per_relation_curve: participant-bootstrap mean direct correctness at every fixed lambda for every one of the eight relations
aggregate_crossing_contract.mean_sign_change_bracket: the first adjacent nonzero grid points [lambda_minus,lambda_plus] with mean c(lambda_minus)>0 and mean c(lambda_plus)<=0; do not interpolate a root
aggregate_crossing_contract.robust_transition_bracket: the last grid point before the first robust-negative point whose bootstrap lower bound is above zero, paired with that first later point whose bootstrap upper bound is below zero
aggregate_crossing_contract.grid_status: robust_positive if the bootstrap lower bound is above zero, robust_negative if the upper bound is below zero, otherwise unresolved; lambda zero is structural_zero

crossing_regime.intermediate: not early and mean sign-change lambda_minus < 0.60
crossing_regime.no_crossing: no positive-to-nonpositive mean transition by lambda 1

aggregate_crossing_contract.primary_relation: H>A, index pair [7,0], prospectively selected by the prior frozen result

subject_crossing_contract.first_crossing_bracket: for each retained subject and relation, the first adjacent nonzero grid pair with c_s(lambda_minus)>0 and c_s(lambda_plus)<=0
subject_crossing_contract.denominator: all retained subjects for that relation, without filtering on competence, initial sign, or crossing
reported: proportion with a fixed-grid positive-to-nonpositive crossing
proportion nonpositive at the first nonzero lambda
median, quartiles, and counts of first crossing brackets among crossing subjects
subject_crossing_contract.boundary: subject brackets describe heterogeneity; no adaptive or subject-specific root solving is permitted

curvature_contract.quadratic_coefficient: K2 = -tanh(b) elementwise-multiplied by [1-tanh(b)^2] elementwise-multiplied by A^2
curvature_contract.taylor_identity: H(lambda) = lambda J_b A + lambda^2 K2 + O(lambda^3)
curvature_contract.scalar_and_hodge_processing: project K2 through the same fixed W_out, orientation contrast, and Hodge residual as the exact path
secondary_estimands: aggregate retained direct correctness of K2
per-relation retained direct correctness of K2
H>A K2 direct correctness minus the within-subject mean of other retained relation K2 correctness
second-order approximation error at each nonzero fixed lambda
curvature_contract.interpretation: negative H>A K2 with weaker or positive other-relation K2 supports a relation-conditioned output-opposed curvature component; call this curvature, not generic saturation

primary_estimands: H>A aggregate mean sign-change and robust-transition brackets in both seeds
H>A subject crossing proportion and fixed-grid bracket distribution in both seeds
all eight per-relation direct-correctness trajectories and crossing regimes
aggregate across-relation direct correctness and normalized rho trajectories

outcome_contingent_v2_selection.isolated_late_H_greater_A_crossing: choose a relation-conditioned amplitude-control v2; global clipping is not justified because the other relations remain correct
outcome_contingent_v2_selection.widespread_late_crossing: choose a globally magnitude-bounded or residualized-expression v2, while preserving global assembly and testing relation controls
outcome_contingent_v2_selection.isolated_early_or_intermediate_H_greater: choose an online relation-conditioned expression or routing v2 rather than a global scalar correction
outcome_contingent_v2_selection.widespread_early_or_intermediate_crossin: choose a fidelity-preserving near-linear residual expression v2 rather than relying on the current finite nonlinear path
outcome_contingent_v2_selection.heterogeneous_or_nonreplicated_crossings: register the simplest online relation-conditioned v2 that predicts the observed heterogeneity; do not continue post hoc localization on seeds 1901 and 1902
outcome_contingent_v2_selection.no_H_greater_A_crossing: treat this as an integrity contradiction with the locked A/J/H result and stop before v2

v2_entry_contract.after_this_gate: do not add further local-fidelity localization on seeds 1901 and 1902
v2_entry_contract.new_development_seeds: one to three seeds not used by the read-only localization series
required_gates: learned-pair local fidelity improves under a frozen estimand
global expected-rank assembly, nonlearned inference, and query binding are preserved
a selective causal intervention supports the proposed expression mechanism
v2_entry_contract.online_computability: the v2 mechanism may use normal query and fast-weight state but not relation LOO, true labels, correctness, or a relation-identity oracle
v2_entry_contract.formal_confirmation: forbidden until a v2 candidate and estimands are frozen after the one-to-three-seed pilot
